The comment above the constants states the basis: the pinned layers are chrome over the rows the reader scrolled to, so the table keeps at least half of the screen it is read on. It also says this ceiling, not the relative arm, covers reports the baseline is not about. The ceiling applies to the open half too, because that bound (strip + slack) also grows with the layer it reads. That is the same class: a strip that grew is invisible to it.
